# Automatos AI

> Expert AI agency and SaaS platform for building and deploying autonomous AI agents. Scaling intelligence, not headcount — multi-agent orchestration with agents, skills, playbooks, and a marketplace to run business operations end-to-end.

Automatos AI is a digital workforce platform where non-engineers can design specialised AI agents, connect them to real tools (Composio, APIs, workspaces), and launch them on sequential or parallel missions. Agents learn from outcomes, collaborate through a coordinator, and are governed by budgets, human-in-the-loop approvals, and full audit trails. Customers bring their own LLM keys (BYOK) or use platform credits.

## Product

- [Platform Overview](https://automatos.app/): What Automatos does, who it's for, and how the digital workforce model differs from a chatbot
- [Design Your Agents](https://automatos.app/design-your-agents): Author specialised agents with skills, tools, and a chosen LLM — no code required
- [Connect Your World](https://automatos.app/connect-your-world): Integrate Composio tools, workspaces, APIs, and knowledge sources
- [Empower With Knowledge](https://automatos.app/empower-with-knowledge): Field memory, documents, and retrieval so agents act on your real context
- [Launch Missions](https://automatos.app/launch-missions): Sequential playbooks and multi-agent coordination with budgets and reporting
- [Marketplace](https://automatos.app/marketplace): Pre-built agents, skills, plugins, and workspace templates installable in one click
